scenario: Uncomplicated Post-Op Knee Arthroplasty Recovery

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hello, I am calling from St. Jude Hospital to check on your recovery after your knee replacement. How are you feeling today?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.text: I'm doing well, thank you. The physical therapist came yesterday and I was able to walk down the hall with my walker.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That is great progress. Are you having any calf swelling or sudden pain in your leg?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.text: No, no swelling in the calf at all. Just normal soreness around the incision that is helped by the Tylenol.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Are you taking your blood thinner medication every day as directed?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.text: Yes, taking my Eliquis every morning without fail.

conversation.text: Have you checked your blood pressure or weight this morning?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.text: Yes, blood pressure was 122 over 78, and my weight has been steady at 178 pounds all week.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Any shortness of breath when walking around the house?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.text: None at all. I walked around the garden this morning.
